name: SWORD GUY
tagline: Has a sword. That's the whole plan.
description: A stick figure with a very big sword, and no plan beyond swinging it.
card: ATTACK  Poke-cut jab, wide ftilt, overhead utilt, floor dtilt
AIR  Spin nair, chop fair, back thrust, up thrust, 3 stabs down
SPECIAL  Boomerang blade; side: hold for the fire DRIVE
DOWN/UP+SPECIAL  Tornado spin (drills down); corkscrew up
